method: SUM(weight_percent * progress_percent / 100), dimensions weights sum 100. Anchor evidence to current repo; subjective estimates not measured experiment outcomes.

dimensions.name: Marco teórico y mecanismos
dimensions.evidence: THEORY_V2.md defines actual implemented mutual compatibility scopes, staged accept/response, 16 periods, algorithmic exposure, private/public feedback and stipulated exits; parameters not calibrated.
dimensions.required_for_100: Rival-specific equations, identifiable estimands, population scope, norms/institutions, alternatives and formal falsifiers linked to observable data.

dimensions.name: Estado del arte
dimensions.evidence: 97 versioned original source records and 30 explicit priors, strong adverse Joel/Baxter/Pronk/Rios/Chang/Ogushi/Matz/Zhao, deduped author GitHub source SRC096 and SRC094.
dimensions.required_for_100: Systematic search protocol, inclusion/exclusion and study overlap audit, strongest competing outcomes and qualified literature synthesis ready for manuscript.

dimensions.name: Simulador ESBM
dimensions.evidence: Executable esbm_dynamic.py, frozen 6x10 scenarios, N144 synthetic agents, 16 ticks, dynamic eligibility/platforms/dissolution; simplistic matching, exogenous hazards, arbitrary weights and identities.
dimensions.required_for_100: Modular mechanisms and independent measurable observables, stateful event chronology, time-to-event censoring handled, negative controls and realistic constraints without forced outcomes.

dimensions.name: Controles técnicos y reproducibilidad
dimensions.evidence: Pre-outcome source freezes, A-J and R1-R5 gate, SHA256 McMaster original and QA code, 60 synthetic scenario QA and byte-identical repeat on same machine; no independent clean clone.
dimensions.required_for_100: Fresh clean-room deterministic replay, unit+property testing, code/data provenance, exposure-preserving strong nulls, CI validation and ready-to-run reproduction package.

dimensions.name: Datos reales y preparación empírica
dimensions.evidence: Columbia, Mixmosa and McMaster original observational samples studied; McMaster 54 actors, two sessions, 357 native bilateral complete dates and SHA256. Original source rights for some other data unknown; no universal harmonized cross-site risk-set dictionary.
dimensions.required_for_100: Licensed complete original datasets from distinct cohorts, harmonized native yes/no and exposure identifiers with missingness and timing, versioned SHA256 and secure controlled access.

dimensions.name: Originalidad científica y baselines competentes
dimensions.evidence: Only one scoped 1/3 finding with subsequent attenuation, 2/3 not established. Risk-set-veto hypothesis PROPOSED_UNVALIDATED; strong existing prior-art SRM, assortments and sequence effects. No strong independent model comparison.
dimensions.required_for_100: Prospectively pre-registered original discriminating prediction surviving matched strong baselines and ablations; adverse results retained with no 2/3 if failed.

dimensions.name: Validación externa independiente
dimensions.evidence: No virgin held-out independently collected original yes/no reciprocal dataset with legal rights, no ESBM heldout model test; within-source actors/2 McMaster sessions insufficient.
dimensions.required_for_100: External other-cohort untouched test, valid intervals/clustering and transport/negative results across populations and settings; no posthoc tuning.

dimensions.name: Producto científico final
dimensions.evidence: Numerous internal reports/ledgers and transparent code, but no finished reproducible journal-style manuscript with defensible central claim and external validation.
dimensions.required_for_100: Complete methods, preregistration, data provenance and tables, independent reproduction, limitations, polished paper and supplement fit for scientific peer review.
